title: Raymarch
description: Five balls melt into a cube, ray-marched per pixel in a single pass. The shapes are a signed distance field built with @typegpu/sdf, and the colours come from Oklab through @typegpu/color. FXAA smooths the edges, and you can turn it off.
line: Five balls melting into a cube, ray-marched in one pass.
hint: drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
